raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: After surfacing conflicting SERP snippets (Find a Grave showing Hollywood Hills vs. Wikipedia/NNDB/Geni showing Glendale), WebSurfer did not click through to the actual source pages to verify details and resolve the discrepancy. Instead, they repeatedly reran the same query and relied on snippets, contrary to the plan to “gather information systematically” and cross-check authoritative sources. This failure to open and verify the Wikipedia entry and the Find a Grave memorial prevented confirming the correct burial at Forest Lawn Memorial Park (Glendale), leading the effort toward an incorrect or unresolved conclusion.
